stories.title: The Glass Case
stories.picture: 博物馆展厅中央，一件带金珠的埃及皮制戏服立在玻璃柜里，讲解员正指向衣服的衬里和针脚。
paragraphs: The museum opened a new exhibition on Friday morning.
博物馆星期五早上开办了一场新展览。
In the middle stood an Egyptian costume.
展厅中央立着一件埃及戏服。
Small gold beads ran down the front.
一排小金珠顺着衣襟向下排列。
The trousers were made of soft leather.
裤子是用柔软的皮革做的。
Inside, the lining had been mended with tiny stitches.
里面的衬里用细密的针脚修补过。
A rusty nail was still caught in a scrap of cloth at the hem.
下摆一块碎布上还挂着一枚生锈的钉子。
Visitors stopped and read the card beside the case.
参观者停下脚步，阅读柜子旁的说明卡片。

stories.title: After the School Play
stories.picture: 学校礼堂后台，几个学生把埃及戏服铺在桌上，有的缝珠子，有的检查裤子的衬里。
paragraphs: The school play needed an Egyptian costume for the final scene.
学校话剧的最后一场需要一件埃及戏服。
Lin stitched loose beads back onto the collar.
林把松掉的珠子重新缝到衣领上。
A scrap of leather was used to patch the trousers.
他们用一块皮革碎料补了裤子。
The lining had a small hole, so they closed it before the show.
衬里有一个小洞，他们在开演前把它缝上了。
Someone found a nail in the pocket and put it in a box.
有人在口袋里发现一枚钉子，便把它放进盒子里。
After the play, the clothes would go into a weekend exhibition in the hall.
演出结束后，这些衣服会放到礼堂里做周末展览。

stories.title: The Tailor's Table
stories.picture: 裁缝店窗边，老裁缝把一件皮制戏服翻开，正在缝衬里，桌上放着珠子、碎布和一枚钉子。
paragraphs: A tailor was asked to repair a leather costume from an exhibition.
有人请裁缝修理一件展览上的皮革戏服。
He turned it over and checked the lining and the trousers.
他把衣服翻过来，检查衬里和裤子。
The Egyptian design was still clear, but two beads were missing.
上面的埃及图案仍然清晰，但少了两颗珠子。
He added a few stitches and kept a scrap of cloth for later.
他又缝了几针，并留了一块碎布备用。
When a loose nail rolled onto the floor, he picked it up and smiled.
一枚松动的钉子滚到地上，他捡起来，笑了笑。
By evening the costume looked ready to wear again.
到了傍晚，这件戏服看起来又能穿了。

stories.title: A Purse with a Note
stories.picture: 公交车站旁，一位年轻侦探打开失而复得的钱包，从里面抽出一张叠好的纸条。
paragraphs: A young detective was assigned to a simple case.
一名年轻侦探被分派去办一件简单的案子。
A woman had lost her purse on the bus.
一位女士在公交车上丢了钱包。
Inside a returned bag, he found a folded paper.
在一只被送回的包里，他发现一张叠好的纸。
The note was the first clue: it had a shop name and a time.
那张纸条是第一条线索：上面有店名和时间。
A photo on the notice board had no caption, so he added one.
布告栏上的照片没有说明文字，于是他补写了一条。
By noon, the owner came and took the purse home.
中午之前，失主来了，把钱包带回了家。

stories.title: The Photo Caption
stories.picture: 教室里，女孩对着一张长椅上红色钱包的照片做记录，照片下方的说明文字很短。
paragraphs: The class was assigned a task: write like a detective for one afternoon.
这天下午，全班被分派了一项任务：像侦探一样写记录。
Mia studied a photo of a red purse on a bench.
米娅仔细看一张长椅上红色钱包的照片。
The caption was short, but it gave no name.
说明文字很短，却没有写出名字。
She looked for a clue in the background.
她在背景里寻找线索。
On the ground lay a piece of paper with a phone number.
地上有一张写着电话号码的纸。
She wrote down the number and finished her report.
她记下号码，完成了报告。

stories.title: The Missing School Bag
stories.picture: 校园布告栏前，侦探模样的学生指着照片下的说明，旁边放着一只找回的钱包和一张纸条。
paragraphs: A detective had been assigned to find a missing school purse.
一名侦探被分派去寻找一只失踪的校园钱包。
The only clue was a caption under a photo on a notice board.
唯一的线索是布告栏上一张照片下的说明文字。
Inside the purse was a paper with the owner's class number.
钱包里有一张纸，上面写着失主的班级号。
He returned it before the last lesson.
他在最后一节课之前把钱包送了回去。

stories.title: Postage for a Disc
stories.picture: 老火车站的窗口前，列车员帮一家旅客给包裹补邮票，包裹里装着光盘和一块肥皂。
paragraphs: The family took a rail tour to an old station museum.
这家人坐火车去参观一座老车站博物馆。
A conductor showed them a box of music discs.
一位列车员给他们看了一盒音乐光盘。
Grandma smiled when she saw her younger self on one film.
奶奶在一段影像里看见年轻时的自己，笑了。
There was not enough postage on a parcel that also held a bar of soap.
一个还装着一块肥皂的包裹，邮资不够。
They bought one more stamp and got back on the train.
他们又买了一张邮票，然后重新上了火车。

stories.title: The Train Gift
stories.picture: 列车车厢里，列车员正帮一个男孩把快要脱落的邮资标签重新贴好，男孩手里拿着光盘和肥皂。
paragraphs: On the rail journey, the conductor collected tickets with a smile.
在这趟铁路旅程上，列车员微笑着收票。
A boy was going on a tour with his uncle.
一个男孩正和叔叔一起去旅行。
He carried a disc of family photos and a small cake of soap as a gift.
他带着一张家庭照片光盘，还有一小块当作礼物的肥皂。
The postage label on his bag had come half off.
他包上的邮资标签已经快要脱落了。
He looked at his tired self in the window and sat up straighter.
他在车窗里看见疲倦的自己，于是坐得更直了些。
The conductor stuck the label back on for him.
列车员帮他把标签重新贴好。

stories.title: Before the Tour
stories.picture: 火车站台边，列车员朝一户人家挥手，孩子提着装了肥皂和光盘的袋子，准备开始旅行。
paragraphs: They packed soap, a disc, and a letter.
他们装好了肥皂、一张光盘，还有一封信。
The postage was more than they expected.
邮资比他们预想的要多。
At the rail station, the conductor called out the platform number.
在火车站，列车员大声报出了站台号。
The tour would last two days.
这次旅行会持续两天。
They wanted photos of their smiling selves at every stop.
他们想在每一站都拍下自己微笑的样子。

stories.title: The Opening Ceremony
stories.picture: 小镇新图书馆门口，管理员拿着登记表迎接前来参加开馆仪式的家庭。
paragraphs: The town opened a new library and held a small ceremony.
镇上开办了新图书馆，并举行了一个小小的仪式。
Many families came to attend it.
许多家庭都来参加。
The librarian asked each visitor to fill in a form.
图书管理员请每位来访者填一张表。
It was convenient, because the library stood next to the school.
这很方便，因为图书馆就在学校旁边。
People said it was a favour to the whole community.
大家都说，这对整个社区都是一件好事。
The librarian would manage the books and the reading room.
图书管理员将负责管理图书和阅览室。

stories.title: A Form and a Favour
stories.picture: 图书馆借阅台前，男孩一边填写表格，一边帮一位老人打印地图。
paragraphs: Ben needed a library card, so he went to attend a short talk at the town library.
本需要办借书证，于是去镇图书馆参加一个短讲座。
The librarian gave him a form and a pen.
图书管理员给了他一张表格和一支笔。
"Could you do me a favour and print this map?" an old man asked.
“能帮我一个忙，把这张地图打印出来吗？”一位老人问。
The printer was convenient, and Ben was happy to help.
打印机就在旁边，很方便，本乐意帮忙。
After the talk, there was a small ceremony for new members.
讲座结束后，还有一个给新读者的小小仪式。
Ben learned how to manage his borrowing dates on the board.
本学会了在公告板上管理自己的借阅日期。

stories.title: Saturday at the Library
stories.picture: 星期六上午，图书馆门口排着队，管理员提着一盒表格，孩子们正等候参加活动仪式。
paragraphs: It was convenient to attend the Saturday ceremony, because it began after breakfast.
参加星期六的仪式很方便，因为它在早饭后才开始。
The town square was already full.
镇广场上已经站满了人。
A librarian stood at the door with a box of forms.
一位图书管理员提着一盒表格站在门口。
She did a favour for a girl who had forgotten her pen.
她帮了一个忘带笔的女孩。
Inside, two students helped manage the line of children.
屋里，两名学生帮忙维持孩子们排成的队伍。
By noon, every form had been collected.
到了中午，所有表格都收齐了。

stories.title: A Rescue by the Pond
stories.picture: 池塘边的野餐垫旁，一名男子分开高草，用绳子把一只小狗从泥里拉上来，旁边停着一辆菜车。
paragraphs: They had planned a picnic beside the pond.
他们本来计划在池塘边野餐。
A small dog slipped on the mud and could not crawl out.
一只小狗在泥里滑倒，爬不出来。
Mr Li was usually laid-back, but he moved fast.
李先生平时很悠闲，这回却动作很快。
He had to force his way through the tall grass with a rope.
他得带着绳子，从高草丛中挤过去。
A vegetable cart stood nearby, and a boy ran to help.
附近停着一辆菜车，一个男孩跑过来帮忙。
Together they completed the rescue, then washed their hands and ate a cucumber.
他们一起完成了营救，然后洗手，吃了一根黄瓜。

stories.title: After the Picnic
stories.picture: 池塘边，孩子们用绳子掀起倒下的树枝，一位农夫停下手推车，从车上拿出一根黄瓜。
paragraphs: After the picnic, the children walked around the pond.
野餐之后，孩子们绕着池塘走。
A duckling had crawled under a fallen branch.
一只小鸭子爬到了倒下的树枝下面。
They did not force it out; they used a soft rope to lift the branch.
他们没有硬把它赶出来，而是用一根软绳子把树枝抬起来。
A laid-back farmer came over with his cart and offered a ride home.
一位脾气很悠闲的农夫推着车走过来，提出送他们回家。
He also gave them a cucumber from a box on the cart.
他还从车上的盒子里给了他们一根黄瓜。
"You did a kind rescue," he said.
“你们做了一次好心的营救。”他说。

stories.title: The Cool Plan
stories.picture: 池塘边的土路上，一辆手推车陷入泥里，有人从车下爬过去系绳子，岸上还有人在吃黄瓜。
paragraphs: The rescue team stayed laid-back even when the cart got stuck near the pond.
即便手推车陷在池塘附近，营救小组也保持冷静。
One man crawled under the cart with a rope.
一名男子拿着绳子，从车子下面爬了过去。
They did not force the wheel; they lifted it together.
他们没有硬扳轮子，而是一起把它抬起来。
A girl eating a cucumber watched and then joined the picnic group on the bank.
一个正在吃黄瓜的女孩看了一会儿，随后加入了岸边的野餐人群。
By sunset, everyone was safe and dry.
到了日落时，大家都安全，而且身上也干了。

stories.title: A Morning Lesson
stories.picture: 教室黑板前，老师画着文章结构示意图，一边讲解习语，一边让学生准备听写和作文。
paragraphs: First they had an English dictation.
他们先进行了英语听写。
Then the teacher asked for a short composition about the weekend.
接着，老师要求写一篇关于周末的短作文。
She explained an idiom and asked the class to use it in a dialogue.
她讲解了一个习语，并让全班用它来编一段对话。
On the board she drew a diagram of the story's parts.
她在黑板上画了一张故事结构示意图。
A demonstration at the front showed how to begin the essay.
讲台前的示范演示了怎样开头写这篇短文。
The students began to write.
学生们开始动笔。

stories.title: Homework on the Table
stories.picture: 书桌前，女孩写完听写后开始写短文，旁边摊开的课本上有一张结构示意图。
paragraphs: Lin finished her dictation and started an essay.
林写完听写，开始写一篇短文。
She wanted to use a new idiom in the first line.
她想在第一句里用一个新习语。
Her partner wrote a dialogue, and they compared their work.
她的同伴写了一段对话，两人一起对照。
A diagram in the textbook made the structure clear.
课本里的示意图把结构讲得很清楚。
Their composition teacher had given a short demonstration the day before.
他们的作文老师前一天做过一次简短的示范。
Lin copied the useful parts into her notebook.
林把有用的部分抄进了笔记本。

stories.title: The Writing Club
stories.picture: 放学后的教室里，写作社成员围坐在一起，桌上放着对话稿、习语卡片和一张结构示意图。
paragraphs: The writing club began with a demonstration of a clear diagram.
写作社先示范了一张清晰的示意图。
Each member read a dialogue and circled one idiom.
每位成员读一段对话，并圈出一个习语。
Then they wrote a composition in twenty minutes.
接着，他们用二十分钟写了一篇作文。
The last task was an essay of only six sentences.
最后一项任务是写一篇只有六句话的短文。
A short dictation of new words closed the meeting.
会议结束前，又进行了一次简短的生词听写。

stories.title: Before the Concert
stories.picture: 音乐厅走廊里，女孩的袖子被门上的夹子挂住，妈妈正帮她整理衣袖，厅内已传来熟悉的曲调。
paragraphs: A familiar tune came from the end of the corridor.
走廊尽头传来一支熟悉的曲调。
Lin was going to a concert with her mother.
林正和妈妈一起去听音乐会。
She caught her sleeve on a door clip, and the cloth started to tear.
她的袖子被门上的夹子挂住，布料开始撕裂。
They still arrived before the first song.
但他们还是在第一首歌开始前赶到了。

stories.title: A Torn Programme
stories.picture: 音乐会结束后，拥挤的走廊里，一个男孩用夹子夹着撕破的节目单，袖子上还沾着灰尘。
paragraphs: After the concert, the corridor was crowded.
音乐会结束后，走廊里挤满了人。
A boy in a familiar jacket had a torn programme in his hand.
一个穿着眼熟外套的男孩，手里拿着一份撕破的节目单。
A clip held the pages together.
一个夹子把书页夹在一起。
His sleeve was dusty from the wall.
他的袖子上沾了墙上的灰尘。
Someone began to hum a tune from the show.
有人开始哼起演出中的一支曲调。
They waited near the door until the crowd moved.
他们在门口等到人群散去。

stories.title: The Lost Clip
stories.picture: 音乐会当晚，走廊墙上的海报角开始撕开，一个女孩拾起掉落的夹子，把它重新夹好。
paragraphs: On concert night, a clip fell off a poster in the corridor.
音乐会那天晚上，走廊里一张海报上的夹子掉了下来。
The poster started to tear at the corner.
海报的角上开始撕开。
A girl in a blue sleeve picked it up and fixed the page.
一个穿着蓝色袖子衣服的女孩把它捡起来，重新夹好。
The tune from the hall was already familiar to her.
厅里传来的曲调她已经很熟悉。
She went in and found a seat at the back.
她走进去，在后排找到一个座位。

stories.title: Tea on a Tray
stories.picture: 窗边的小桌上，妈妈把饼干从铁盒里取出放进托盘，椅子上放着软垫，午后的阳光很温和。
paragraphs: Mum put biscuits from a tin onto a tray.
妈妈把铁盒里的饼干放进托盘。
She tucked a napkin under the cups.
她把一张餐巾纸掖在杯子下面。
A soft cushion waited on the chair by the window.
窗边的椅子上放着一个软垫。
It was a pleasant afternoon, with weak sunlight.
那是一个愉快的下午，阳光不烈。
"Don't shake the tray," she said, laughing.
“别晃托盘。”她笑着说。
Grandpa took a biscuit and smiled.
爷爷拿了一块饼干，笑了。

stories.title: A Pleasant Visit
stories.picture: 客厅茶几上放着一盒饼干和托盘，客人把包塞到沙发垫旁边，窗外起风，窗框轻轻晃动。
paragraphs: Auntie brought a tin of biscuits and set them on a tray.
阿姨带来一铁盒饼干，把它们放在托盘上。
The guest tucked her bag beside a cushion on the sofa.
客人把包塞到沙发上的垫子旁边。
They had a pleasant talk about the garden.
她们愉快地聊着花园里的事。
The window began to shake in the wind, so they closed it.
窗户在风里开始晃动，于是她们把窗关上了。
More tea was poured, and the tin was almost empty.
茶又续上了，铁盒也快空了。

stories.title: After Dinner
stories.picture: 晚饭后的客厅里，孩子把托盘端进厨房，奶奶坐在软垫上，把毯子掖好，铁盒里还剩一块饼干。
paragraphs: Dad asked the children not to shake the table.
爸爸叮嘱孩子们不要晃桌子。
They carried a tray of cups into the kitchen.
他们把装着杯子的托盘端进厨房。
The last biscuit in the tin was left for Grandma.
铁盒里最后一块饼干留给了奶奶。
She sat on a cushion and tucked a blanket around her knees.
她坐在垫子上，把毯子掖在膝盖周围。
The house felt quiet and pleasant.
屋里安静而愉快。

stories.title: The Speaking Class
stories.picture: 口语课上，老师让学生放慢语速、用手势配合表情练习，后排一个情绪低落的男孩正准备开口。
paragraphs: The teacher said a facial expression can influence your voice.
老师说，面部表情会影响声音。
She asked them to slow their pace and take air into the lungs.
她让大家放慢节奏，把空气吸入肺里。
A small gesture with the hands made the words clearer.
一个小小的手势让话语更清楚了。
One downhearted boy sat in the back and did not speak at first.
一个情绪低落的男孩坐在后排，起初没有说话。
After a few tries, his face relaxed, and he finished his sentence.
试了几次后，他的表情放松了，把那句话说完了。

stories.title: Before the Talk
stories.picture: 上台前，女孩对着镜子练习表情和手势，朋友在一旁提醒她放慢速度，深吸一口气。
paragraphs: Mina felt downhearted before her talk.
米娜在发言前感到有些沮丧。
Her friend said, "Slow your pace and add one gesture."
朋友说：“放慢节奏，再加上一个手势。”
Mina practised in front of a mirror and watched her facial expression.
米娜对着镜子练习，观察自己的面部表情。
She took a deep breath into her lungs.
她深深吸了一口气，让空气进入肺里。
The kind words had a real influence, and she walked onto the stage.
那些暖心的话真的起了影响，她走上了台。

stories.title: A Warmer Voice
stories.picture: 教室里，学生们一边做手势一边练习发声，老师提醒他们保持稳定的节奏，连情绪低落时也要带一点微笑。
paragraphs: When you gesture, more air can enter the lungs.
做手势时，会有更多空气进入肺里。
That may influence the warmth of your voice.
这可能会影响声音的温暖程度。
A facial smile also helps, even if you still feel downhearted.
即使你仍然感到沮丧，一个面部的微笑也会有帮助。
Keep a steady pace, and the listeners will stay with you.
保持稳定的节奏，听的人就会跟得上。
The class tried this together and heard the difference.
全班一起试了试，听见了其中的差别。

stories.title: The Art Room
stories.picture: 美术室里，学生们在安静的音乐中画画，老师鼓励大家不必紧张，让各自的想法展现在墙上。
paragraphs: The first activity was drawing with quiet music.
第一项活动是在安静的音乐里画画。
Some students felt stress about making a perfect picture.
有些学生因为想画得完美而感到压力。
The teacher said it was not an unpleasant test, just practice.
老师说这不是一次令人不快的测验，只是练习。
She hoped each artistic idea would shine in its own way.
她希望每一个有艺术感的想法都能以自己的方式展现出来。
By the end, the wall was full of colour.
结束时，整面墙都布满了色彩。

stories.title: Colour After School
stories.picture: 放学后的美术社里，女孩把上午的不快画进一张鲜艳的海报里，颜色让她的心情渐渐亮起来。
paragraphs: An unpleasant morning had left Lin full of stress.
一个令人不快的上午，让林心里满是压力。
The art club was her favourite activity.
美术社是她最喜欢的活动。
She tried an artistic poster with bright paint.
她用鲜艳的颜料做了一张富有艺术感的海报。
Slowly her mood began to shine through the colours.
渐渐地，她的心情从这些颜色里展现出来。

stories.title: A Quiet Project
stories.picture: 星期五的教室里，学生们不慌不忙地完成艺术活动，作品在灯光下显得很亮。
paragraphs: The school planned an artistic activity for Friday.
学校为星期五安排了一项艺术活动。
There was no stress and no unpleasant race to finish first.
没有压力，也没有令人不快的抢先比赛。
Students let their work shine under the classroom lights.
学生们让自己的作品在教室灯光下展现出来。
Parents later said the pictures felt fresh and kind.
家长后来都说，这些画看起来清新而友善。

stories.title: A New Picture Tool
stories.picture: 电脑课上，女孩对着屏幕里的桌面快照做精确编辑，并放大画面的一角，旁边还开着 Verse 的教程。
paragraphs: Lin was eligible for the early access of a picture tool.
林获得了这款绘图工具抢先体验版的使用资格。
She took a snapshot of her desk and tried a precise edit.
她拍了一张书桌的快照，并尝试做一次精确编辑。
The tool could enlarge a corner without making it unclear.
这个工具能放大画面的一角，又不会让它变模糊。
A multi-step task appeared on the screen.
屏幕上出现了一项多步骤的任务。
The teacher said this model had done well on a Rapidata list.
老师说，这个模型在 Rapidata 的一份名单上表现很好。
Lin also opened a short lesson on a language called Verse.
林还打开了一节关于一种叫 Verse 的语言的短课。

stories.title: The Test List
stories.picture: 社团活动室里，几个学生按多步骤计划处理快照，成绩将出现在 Rapidata 的页面上。
paragraphs: Only club members were eligible to try the early access version.
只有社团成员才有资格试用这个抢先体验版。
They had to follow a multi-step plan: snapshot, then enlarge the result.
他们必须按多步骤计划进行：先拍快照，再放大结果。
One girl added a precise edit before she saved the file.
有个女孩在保存文件前又做了一次精确编辑。
Scores were posted on a Rapidata page the next morning.
第二天早上，分数被发在 Rapidata 的页面上。
One boy wrote a tiny game in Verse and added a picture later.
一个男孩用 Verse 写了一个小游戏，稍后再配上了图。

stories.title: After Computer Class
stories.picture: 机房放学后，女孩对着黑板上的快照做精确编辑，并询问自己能否再使用一周抢先体验版。
paragraphs: In the computer room, a snapshot of the board was still on the screen.
机房里，屏幕上还留着黑板的一张快照。
Mia used a precise edit to cut the edge, then chose enlarge.
米娅用精确编辑裁掉边缘，然后选择放大。
She was eligible to keep the early access for another week.
她有资格再使用一周这个抢先体验版。
Her homework included one multi-step exercise and three lines of Verse.
她的作业包括一道多步骤练习，以及三行 Verse。
"Did we beat the Rapidata score?" someone asked, and the teacher smiled.
“我们有没有超过 Rapidata 上的分数？”有人问，老师笑了。

stories.title: A Book of Oceans
stories.picture: 科学课上，老师翻开一本分章介绍北极和大西洋的书，旁边放着卫星照片和望远镜图。
paragraphs: The book had a part for the Arctic and a part for the Atlantic.
这本书有一章写北极，有一章写大西洋。
A map showed every continent in a different colour.
一张地图用不同颜色标出了每一块大陆。
An expert on space talked about junk around the Earth.
一位空间方面的专家谈到了地球周围的垃圾。
A satellite photo was placed next to a picture from a telescope.
一张卫星照片被放在一张望远镜拍到的图片旁边。
Some students had doubt about the numbers, but the teacher explained them.
有些学生对这些数字感到怀疑，但老师做了解释。
One failure in an old launch was also on the page.
书页上还写着一次旧发射任务的失败。

stories.title: Night on the Roof
stories.picture: 夜色里，几个学生在屋顶支起望远镜寻找卫星，专家正在讲解太空垃圾的问题。
paragraphs: They set up a telescope to look for a satellite.
他们支起望远镜，寻找一颗卫星。
"Junk in space," the expert said, "can be as small as a screw."
专家说，太空中的垃圾可能只有一颗螺丝那么小。
Nobody had doubt that the Arctic night would be clearer than a city night.
没有人怀疑，北极的夜会比城市的夜更清澈。
Across the Atlantic, another school was watching too.
在大西洋的另一边，也有一所学校在观望。
A past failure had taught them to check the stand twice.
一次过去的失败教会他们要把支架检查两遍。
Later they marked each continent they had discussed.
后来，他们标出了讨论过的每一块大陆。

stories.title: The Science Club
stories.picture: 科学社活动中，专家拿出望远镜模型，讲解卫星如何拍摄大西洋和北极，并谈到清理失败的风险。
paragraphs: An expert brought a model of a telescope to the science club.
一位专家把一个望远镜模型带到了科学社。
She showed how a satellite collects pictures of the Atlantic and the Arctic.
她演示卫星如何拍摄大西洋和北极的图片。
"Space junk is a real problem," she said, without any doubt.
“太空垃圾是个真正的问题。”她说，语气里没有丝毫怀疑。
A failure to clean old parts could hurt a future flight.
如果没能清理旧零件，这次失败可能会影响将来的飞行。
The club then drew the continent outlines from memory.
接着，社员凭记忆画出了大陆的轮廓。

stories.title: A Book about an Empire
stories.picture: 灯下，一本畅销书摊开在桌上，插图里有一门大炮、一辆旧车，还有客栈和酒馆的招牌。
paragraphs: A best-seller told how a young servant travelled across an old empire.
一本畅销书写一名年轻仆人如何走遍一个古老的帝国。
He would fly from one city to another in a government vehicle.
他会乘坐公家的交通工具，从一座城市飞到另一座城市。
At night he slept at a small inn, or ate in a tavern by the river.
夜里，他睡在一家小客栈，或者在河边的酒馆吃饭。
In one chapter, soldiers pulled a cannon through the mud.
有一章里，士兵们拖着一门大炮走过泥地。
The book also explained how people used salt to preserve meat.
书里还写了人们怎样用盐保存肉类。
Readers said the writer helped restore interest in that period.
读者们说，作者重新唤起了人们对那个时代的兴趣。

stories.title: The Old Inn
stories.picture: 院落里停着一辆帝国年代的木制车子，门边是正在修复的客栈和酒馆，花园里还摆着一门旧炮。
paragraphs: The owner wanted to restore an old inn and a tavern next door.
主人想修复一家旧客栈，以及隔壁的酒馆。
A wooden vehicle from the empire years stood in the yard.
院子里停着一辆帝国年代的木制车子。
A rusted cannon was kept in the garden, just to look at.
花园里还留着一门生锈的大炮，只是供人观看。
The owner, once a servant in a big house, now cooked for guests.
这位主人曾经在一栋大房子里当仆人，如今为客人做饭。
He used family methods to preserve fruit for the winter.
他用家里传下来的方法为冬天保存水果。
A best-seller on the shelf described someone who would fly this route a century ago.
书架上的一本畅销书写到，一百年前也有人乘飞机走过这条路线。

stories.title: On the Road
stories.picture: 山坡客栈对面是一家旧酒馆，向导指着山上的古炮遗址，主人端出蜜饯迎接刚下车的旅客。
paragraphs: They would fly to the coast, then take a local vehicle to a hillside inn.
他们将先乘飞机到海边，再换乘当地的交通工具，前往山坡上的客栈。
A tavern across the street still used a sign from the empire days.
街对面的酒馆仍使用帝国时期的招牌。
A guide tried to restore the old story of a cannon on the hill.
向导试图恢复山上那门大炮的旧故事。
The inn keeper, like a careful servant, came out to welcome them.
客栈主人像一位细心的仆人，出门来迎接他们。
He offered preserved plums and a page from a local best-seller.
他端出腌制的李子，还附上当地一本畅销书里的一页。
The guests sat down and opened their maps.
客人们坐下来，打开了地图。
